summary: NextTrip, Inc. filed an 8-K reporting an exchange agreement effective August 25, 2026, with Monaco Investment Partners II, LP, converting $3,000,000 in outstanding line-of-credit debt plus accrued interest into Series B convertible preferred stock at $1,000 stated value per share, along with a $500,000 credit increase. The lender is controlled by chairman Donald P. Monaco; disinterested directors and audit committee approved it under related-party rules. The preferred stock was issued unregistered without an exemption specified. The transaction eliminates debt and shifts exposure to equity, reducing leverage but potentially diluting common shareholders upon conversion. Watch for conversion terms, dilution, and related-party governance scrutiny.
